summary_en: ¥100M acquisition of Infinity Life (M&A and real-estate brokerage) for 100% stake and complete subsidiary status. Total transaction value ¥105M including advisory costs. Settlement scheduled July 1, 2026. Target company reported ¥129M sales, ¥24M recurring profit for FY3/25.
title_en: Entry into Business Succession and M&A Intermediation Services and Acquisition of All Shares of Infinity Life Co., Ltd. (Complete Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
PostPrime Inc. announced on 17 June 2026 that its board has decided to acquire 100% of the issued shares of Infinity Life Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-based M&A and real-estate brokerage firm, and integrate it as a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition price for the target company's shares is ¥100 million, with estimated advisory and related fees of ¥5 million, for a total transaction value of ¥105 million. Settlement is scheduled for 1 July 2026, with cash payment.

Infinity Life specializes in M&A intermediation for education and real-estate sectors and has demonstrated strong growth, achieving ¥129 million in sales and ¥24 million in recurring profit in the fiscal year ended 31 March 2025 (approximately double prior-year profit). The firm won the deal-completion count award in the 2025 Batons M&A Professional Awards.

PostPrime intends to leverage its SNS platform (43,000 users) to distribute practical M&A content, expand deal-sourcing channels for Infinity Life, and improve user engagement and monetization. The acquisition positions the PostPrime group to establish dual revenue streams in financial-information and M&A intermediation services. Acquisition price was determined by reference to recent financial performance, revenue projections, third-party DCF valuation, and estimated business synergies.
